message.content: {"draft":"Hypothesis: 32x32 blocks underutilize SMs on 1024x1024 (10.5us vs 2.15us). Coordinate check: out[i,j]=x[j,i]; flat out=i*M+j, in=j*N+i. Edge (326,327): out=326*327+327, in=327*326+326. Fix: larger 64x64 blocks.","plan":"Verify masks: offs_m<M, offs_n<N. Padded loads use other=0.0. Store mask=mask.T. Output (N,M) contiguous. 64x64 blocks reduce grid to 16x16 for 1024x1024. No dtype cast needed; pointer types match. Allocate fresh contiguous output.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N,","                     BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr):","    pid_m = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    pid_n = tl.program_id(axis=1)","    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)","    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)","    mask_m = offs_m < M","    mask_n = offs_n < N","    mask = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]","    x_ptrs = x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * N + offs_n[None, :]","    x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=mask, other=0.0)","    out_ptrs = out_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :]","    tl.store(out_ptrs, x.T, mask=mask.T)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()","    M, N = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((N, M), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    BLOCK_M = 64","    BLOCK_N = 64","    grid = (triton.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M), triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N))","    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK_M=BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N)","    return out"]}
